description: Enable or disable reservations and set the notice address. Enabling requires a notice address. Takes no idempotency key. A retry with the same values sets the same configuration.

blockedDates.description: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) or { from, to } ranges, inclusive, in the venue time zone, on which no bookings are taken. Replaces the list. An empty list clears it.

maxActivePerGuestPerDay.description: The most active bookings one guest, identified by contact, may hold on one date. Null turns it off.

maxAdvanceDays.description: Refuse bookings more than this many days ahead, counted from today in the venue time zone. Null turns it off.

overbookingCeiling.description: The most covers the venue accepts without tables at one time. 0 means every booking holds tables.

phoneCountry.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country for phone numbers without a country code. Null follows the venue time zone.

name: venue.setConfig
title: Set venue config
